description: This Java source file defines an event listener class AuthenticationSuccessListener that handles successful authentication events in a Spring application. It resets the failed login attempts for a user when authentication succeeds.

classes.name: AuthenticationSuccessListener
classes.description: A Spring component that listens for successful authentication events and resets the user's failed login attempts if applicable.

methods.description: Constructor that takes a UserService instance for user operations.

methods.name: onApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles AuthenticationSuccessEvent, resets user's failed login attempts if found.
